_note: Website-only settings. Items, prices, photos and stock live in Square (Square Dashboard > Items). This file says which Square categories appear on the website and in what order, plus a few things Square doesn't hold.

menuOrder._how: The order drinks show in on the website, per coffee category: strongest coffee to milkiest, tea last. Names match Square's ignoring capitals and any size in brackets. Drinks not listed show after these, in Square's order.

delivery._how: Delivery is charged per km of one-way driving distance from the shop, and refused past maxKm. perKm is in cents (125 = $1.25), and minFee is the least a delivery costs, in cents (1000 = $10). The rate and the distance can also be changed at /admin.html, which wins over these. lat/lon are the shop's spot on the map, for working out distances.
delivery.from: 41 King St E, Omemee, ON K0L 2W0

_requiredChoices: Square modifier sets (by name) that customers must pick from on the website, so there's no None option. Square's own Require a selection switch also counts when Square sends it.
_hours: Opening hours come from Square (Square Dashboard > Account & Settings > Business information > Locations > Business hours), and coffee pickup times are only offered while the shop is open. Only if Square has no hours set, these are used instead, in Square's shape, e.g. {"day_of_week": "MON", "start_local_time": "07:00", "end_local_time": "15:00"}. Closed days from /admin.html still apply on top.
_lastCoffeeMins: Last coffee orders (as soon as possible or a chosen time) this many minutes before closing.

christmas._how: Christmas pre-orders. List the Square item names that are Christmas-only under items, and the pickup/delivery days as YYYY-MM-DD under dates, e.g. ["2026-12-20", "2026-12-23"]. While dates is empty, these items sell like any other flowers. Once dates are set, customers ordering them must choose one of those days at checkout. orderAheadDays is how many days before a day it stops taking orders (1 = order by the day before).

focus._how: Photo focus spots, by Square item name, as "across% down%" (50% 50% is the centre). The site keeps this spot in view however it crops the photo. Normally you set these at /focus.html, which saves them on the item in Square; a spot saved there wins over this list.
